# Moderators and Curators {#sec-people}

<!-- Generated by tools/generate.py from governance.toml, i18n/languages.toml and the front matter of each page. Do not edit by hand. -->

The people who look after the book. Maintainers look after the whole repository. Moderators
look after a part: they review the changes to its pages and triage its issues. Curators look
after single pages and review their living reviews. Translators look after the book in another
language. People are named by their GitHub handle. How the roles work, and how to take one, is in
[GOVERNANCE.md](https://github.com/the-alan-machine/the-alan-machine/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md).
